title: Improving Decision Making About Feeding Options for Dementia
brief_summary: This study is a randomized trial to test whether a decision aid can help to improve the quality of decision making about feeding options in care of patients with dementia.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* dementia diagnosis
* advanced cognitive impairment
* feeding problem
* age \>= 65
* surrogate decision maker

Exclusion Criteria:

* feeding tube decision made
* hospice
* BMI \> 26
* major psychosis or developmental delay
